I am disappointed with this one as it is highly over priced also cane juice was not they way it is,they use some essence in juice .

featured_reviews.name: Parry
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is inside the Society Stores compound.
Pros: Machine made, no added sugar, no hand's involved, served in a disposable cup, no water added. The guy at the stall isn't friendly but not even rude. He is fine.
Con's: I don't know how hygienic it is but since they don't use their hands or mix water to the juice, it appears to be hygienic in comparison to the roadside ganna-walas. I don't know if they clean their machines. I had asked them once and they said yes but I don't know if that is true. Price wise it is a bit pricey (Rs.50 for small cup and Rs.70 for large cup) but if you think that it is hygienic then it is worth the price. According to Google, surgarcane can be refrigerated for up to 2 weeks. I don't know for how long they store but since the place gets very crowded in the evening and looking at this high turnaround I think their sugarcane is fresh.
I like it here because the juice is very sweet and tastes fresh. So far, I haven't had any complains.
Tips: Don't go in the evening, it gets very crowded.

featured_reviews.name: Tariq Theba
featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm extremely disappointed with my recent experience with Kurla Juice Hut's Jogeshwari West branch. I ordered two veg melting sandwiches, which took an astonishing 1 hour and 20 minutes to arrive, despite being only 2.5 km away from my location.

The sandwiches themselves were a letdown. They were not fresh, not warm, and seemed to have been prepared long before my order. To make matters worse, they were excessively salty, rendering them inedible.

What's more, the order was incomplete, as they forgot to include the usual accompaniments of chutney and mayonnaise.

I tried to report the issue to Zomato support, but they claimed they couldn't validate the issue with the restaurant.

To add insult to injury, when I called the restaurant to inform them about the issue, they disconnected the call twice, without even bothering to listen to my concerns.

I've been a loyal customer of Kurla Juice Hut's Kurla branch in the past, but this experience has left a sour taste. The service has clearly deteriorated since the opening of this new branch.

Unless they seriously revamp their quality control, delivery, and customer service, I would strongly advise against ordering from this branch.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Amar Juice Centre, a place I’d heard quite a bit about—especially for its pav bhaji.

I tried the butter pav bhaji and a mango shake. To be honest, the pav bhaji didn’t quite live up to the hype for me. It was decent, but nothing particularly memorable, and it didn’t really satisfy that nostalgic craving for authentic Mumbai-style pav bhaji that I was hoping for.

The mango shake, however, was the standout. It was fresh, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the visit.

The setup is pretty straightforward—located right on the main road, with a stand-and-eat format. You can also enjoy your food in your parked car, which is quite convenient. The staff was courteous, and the service was impressively quick, which adds to the overall ease of the experience.

Overall, Amar Juice Centre is worth a stop for its juices and quick bites, but if you're going in with high expectations for the pav bhaji, you might find it a bit underwhelming.

featured_reviews.name: Abdullah Nore
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have visited multiple Baba Falooda branches over the years — Mahim, Crawford Market, and Andheri — and I always had a small request: please don’t add extra sugar syrup because my dad has diabetes and I personally prefer less sweetness. Every branch always understood and respected this request.

Recently at the Crawford Market branch, I even requested them to customize my order a little differently. Personally, I feel the regular increment-only flavours are subpar, while the kulfi-mix flavours like Green Pista and Malai Top taste much better — they’re just a bit too sweet for me. So I requested them not to add the Malai Kulfi or Pista Kulfi in those faloodas and instead make the base more ice-cream focused. The staff politely informed me that the taste would change, but I was completely fine with that, and honestly, I ended up liking it much more that way. The staff at these branches have always been polite, understanding, and delightful.

Today, however, I visited the Kurla branch of Baba Falooda, and the experience was extremely disappointing. Since it was a new branch for me, I was excited to try it and thought I would continue visiting this branch every year like the others.

Initially, the staff seemed ready to accommodate my request, but one staff member behaved very unprofessionally and refused, saying it was “more work.” That attitude was upsetting. People have different health conditions and taste preferences — some have diabetes, some prefer less sugar — and every other Baba Falooda branch has always understood this simple request except the Kurla branch.

I was extremely hungry at the time, but the rude and egoistic behavior of that staff member completely spoiled the experience for me. This review is being posted because I’m speaking about Baba Falooda as a franchise overall. After today’s experience, I genuinely do not feel like visiting any Baba Falooda branch again.

featured_reviews.name: Md. Farhan Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a dessert lover in Mumbai, Baba Falooda is an absolute must-visit! The place is famous for its rich and refreshing faloodas that perfectly balance sweetness, texture, and flavor. The falooda comes loaded with creamy kulfi, silky vermicelli, basil seeds, and generous scoops of ice cream, making every bite incredibly satisfying.
What makes Baba Falooda special is the authentic taste and generous portion size. The kulfi is dense and flavorful, and the combination with rose syrup and chilled milk creates a dessert that’s both refreshing and indulgent. Despite being extremely popular and often crowded, the service is quick and efficient.
Whether you go after dinner or just to satisfy a sweet craving, Baba Falooda never disappoints. It’s one of those iconic Mumbai dessert spots that truly lives up to the hype.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried a few flavors at Baba Falooda recently. The Mango, Malai, and Pista faloodas were all delicious—rich, flavorful, and definitely worth ordering. I'd recommend sticking to Mango, Malai, or Pista and giving the Black Currant a miss.
Overall, a great spot for a refreshing falooda fix!

featured_reviews.name: Manish Dhanavade
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐ (for Jogeshwari) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (for Mahim)

Having had an excellent experience at Baba Falooda, Mahim, I was excited to try their new branch in Jogeshwari, but unfortunately, it was quite disappointing. The experience was not even 50% of what Mahim offers.

The ice cream and kulfi quality and quantity were not up to the mark, lacking the rich, creamy texture that Baba Falooda is known for. The dry fruits were sparse, and the overall falooda felt ordinary rather than indulgent. The taste, richness, and generosity that define the Mahim outlet were clearly missing.

Mahim continues to set a very high benchmark with its creamy, rich falooda and generous toppings, but the Jogeshwari branch has a long way to go to match that standard. I genuinely hope they improve consistency across outlets, because the brand name carries strong expectations.

Recommendation:
For the true Baba Falooda experience, Mahim is still the place to go. Jogeshwari needs significant improvement in quality, quantity, and overall execution.

featured_reviews.name: DNB Travel & Food Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Visited Bunty Juice Center – One of the Most Famous Juice & Snack Spots in Borivali

Visited Bunty Juice Center in Borivali West and had a really enjoyable experience. This place is very popular for its huge variety of juices, shakes, desserts, sandwiches, and snacks with unique presentation style.

🍹 Food & Drinks:
The menu is extremely creative with interesting names and unique serving style. Must-try items include Gabbar Mango Shake, Kiwi Strawberry Juice, Chocolate Thali, Strawberry Cream, Festival Pizza, Chowpatty Sandwich, and Jungli Sandwich. Taste was fresh, flavorful, and presentation was eye-catching.

🍨 Desserts & Presentation:
Desserts and shakes are one of the biggest highlights here. The presentation is very different and trendy, which makes it fun especially for youngsters and families.

💰 Price:
Approx ₹250–₹500 per person depending on your order. Some items feel slightly premium priced, but quantity and creativity balance it well.

🏠 Ambience:
The place has colorful interiors, vibrant atmosphere, and cozy seating. It is usually crowded in evenings and weekends because of its popularity.

👨‍🍳 Staff & Service:
Staff is generally helpful and service is quick even during rush hours. They also guide properly if you are confused by the large menu.

🚗 Parking:
Parking can be difficult during peak time because the area gets crowded. Better to visit slightly early in evenings. They have Velvet parking facility too.

🧼 Cleanliness:
Overall cleanliness is decent considering the heavy crowd, though seating gets busy during peak hours.

📌 Overall:
Great place for juices, desserts, and innovative snacks with fun presentation. Perfect hangout spot for friends and family in Borivali.

Highly recommended 👍

featured_reviews.name: Girlbehindthebrands
featured_reviews.review_text:
When Juices Steal the Show & Food Blows Your Mind! 🍹🍕🔥
Hidden in the heart of Borivali, Bunty’s Snacks & Juice Center is an absolute delight for anyone who loves experimenting with new flavours! 😍

Let’s start with the juices — honestly, they stole the show! From the tangy twist of Captain Juice to the vibrant, colourful Rangoli Juice, each one is refreshing and full of unique blends. The Salaar Juice packs a real punch — bold, chilled, and energizing — while Darna Mana Hai Juice is a fun, must-try surprise for brave hearts! 🥤

Moving to food, every bite is pure comfort. The Humpty Dumpty Toast is a crunchy, cheesy treat that instantly wins you over. The Festival Pizza truly lives up to its name — loaded, flavourful, and festive in every bite! 🍕 The Nachni Bhel is a healthy yet tasty twist, and the Gol Gappa Kabab is a total showstopper — chatpata, crunchy, and bursting with flavour!

And just when you think it can’t get better, the Strawberry Cream and Film City Dessert arrive to seal the deal — creamy, dreamy, and picture-perfect endings! 🍓🍨

If you’re in Borivali and haven’t been here yet, you’re missing out on a local gem. Great taste, quick service, and a vibe that makes you want to come back again and again

featured_reviews.name: kajol patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bunty Cafe is a charming establishment that offers both indoor air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating, allowing guests to enjoy their meals in a setting that suits their preference. One of the standout features of this cafe is its popular range of juices, which are served in a visually appealing and creative way. The presentation adds an extra touch to the overall experience, making it more enjoyable.

A particular highlight was the Chaupati Sandwich, which was full of flavor and left a lasting impression. However, the pasta was a bit of a disappointment. Instead of the expected pasta sauce, it had a taste resembling a paneer gravy, which was not quite what one would expect from a pasta dish.

For dessert, the Strawberry Cream was quite delightful, offering a nice balance of sweetness and freshness. Additionally, the cafe offers a variety of funky juices, each presented with a unique setup that adds to the overall appeal. Although the juice setups are quite fancy, the juices themselves are priced higher than expected, but they remain fairly average in terms of taste.

The ambience of the cafe is simple and unassuming, but it provides a comfortable space for conversations and casual hangouts. It's a great spot for a relaxed chit-chat with friends or family, making it an ideal place to spend time with loved ones over a refreshing drink.
